visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short, tinted mauve hair and a black ribbed sweater stands in a brightly lit subway station, smiling at the camera while holding a beige strap. Behind her are station tiles and a green floor guidance line. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a celebratory setting where the woman, a man in a navy turtleneck, and a toddler in a patterned vest stand before gold and green balloons; the woman holds the child while the man looks at a smartphone. (3) A hand holds a MUJI branded brown paper shopping bag in a blurred retail environment. (4) Close-ups show MUJI food kits (rice seasonings) organized on wooden shelves under warm retail lighting; the woman is later seen in a kitchen stirring a rice cooker pot with a black spoon. (5) High-quality food photography displays four bowls of prepared seasoned rice on a light-colored table. (6) A hand unboxes and holds a small wooden hairbrush cleaning tool with stiff black bristles, demonstrating its use by scraping a large wooden paddle brush to remove accumulated hair fibers. (7) The woman brushes her hair with a clean brush in a bathroom with a wooden door. (8) Liquid blush products are showcased on retail shelves; a social media screenshot on a phone displays blush swatches, followed by a demonstration of applying the pink cream to a hand and then the woman's cheek. (9) The woman holds a compact, white portable lint roller, demonstrating how to pull it open and roll it across the sleeve of her grey sweater. (10) A wide shot of a MUJI store section displays neatly folded pajamas and innerwear on racks and tables under soft studio lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: MUJI 無印良品. [Subtitle]: 又去我最愛的無印良品. (2) [Subtitle]: 大家好 我是在東京育兒的RU醬. (3) [Subtitle]: 跟大家分享 我前幾天去無印補的貨. (4) [Subtitle]: 各種炊飯調理包. [Subtitle]: 我最常回購的區域. [Subtitle]: 把調理包跟米 放進電鍋一起煮. [Subtitle]: 就會變成 超好吃的炊飯. (5) [Subtitle]: 真的是 懶人必備的高級料理. [Subtitle]: 我自己最愛 鮭魚舞菇口味. (6) [Subtitle]: 山毛櫸髮梳清潔刷. [Subtitle]: 簡單來說就是 梳子用的梳子. [Subtitle]: 刷幾下就可以刷出 卡在上面的頭髮跟灰塵. [Subtitle]: 清的超乾淨. [Subtitle]: 硬度夠而且很高. [Subtitle]: 很多梳子都適用. [Subtitle]: 有乾淨的梳子 才有健康的頭皮. (7) [Subtitle]: 液體腮紅霜. [Subtitle]: 日本現在超紅. [Subtitle]: 軟管包裝 質地水潤滑順. [Subtitle]: 共有3色. [Subtitle]: 1號色是橘色調. [Subtitle]: 2號色是我買的玫瑰粉. [Subtitle]: 3號色是新的清新淡粉色. [Subtitle]: 我去買的時候 新色缺貨了嗚嗚 (大家有買到的話跟我說). (8) [Subtitle]: 攜帶型衣物用 清潔滾輪. [Subtitle]: 外出衣物黏到毛絮或灰塵 可以馬上清. [Subtitle]: 一支比手機還小. [Subtitle]: 帶出門超級方便. [Subtitle]: 真不愧是 重視細節的日本出的產品 (還有補補充滾輪喔!). (9) [Subtitle]: 大家也跟我分享 你們常買的商品吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright acoustic guitar strums and a rhythmic beat begin. A female voice speaks with high pitch and an enthusiastic, friendly tone, introducing her favorite store. (2) The narration continues seamlessly as the background environment shifts; faint rustling of a paper bag is heard over the persistent upbeat BGM. (3) A subtle percussive metallic sound or mechanical click occurs as food kits are highlighted, followed by the soft sound of a spoon scraping against a metal pot in the kitchen. (4) The audio transitions with the woman describing a hairbrush tool; a distinct scratching and rustling sound of bristles against hair is heard prominently over the music. (5) As blush is demonstrated, the acoustic music maintains a constant tempo and energy; the narrator's voice remains clear with professional articulation. (6) A sharp clicking sound of a plastic lid opening and the faint friction of a lint roller moving across fabric are captured before the final upbeat closing statement.
